faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is HealthAssist AI a replacement for a doctor?
faq.a1: No. HealthAssist AI provides general health information and AI-generated estimates to help you understand your health. It does not diagnose conditions. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.
faq.a2: Each model is evaluated on held-out test data, and its measured performance is shown with the results. No model is perfect, and results can be wrong, so treat them as a starting point for a conversation with a doctor.
faq.q3: Who can see my health information?
faq.a3: Only you. Your records are tied to your account and protected on the server. You can download or delete your data at any time.
faq.a4: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Urdu, Kannada, Odia and Malayalam.
faq.a5: Creating an account and using the platform is free.
faq.q6: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.a6: Yes. The platform works in any modern web browser on phones, tablets and computers.

about.title: About the application
about.p1: HealthAssist AI is an AI-based personal health and lifestyle assistant. It brings disease prediction, a healthcare chatbot, hospital discovery and diet planning together in a single web platform.
about.p2: It is built to support preventive care: helping people notice possible concerns early, understand them in plain language, and take sensible next steps, including seeing a doctor.

legal.privacyBody:
We collect the information you provide (account details, health profile, and records you create) only to deliver the features you use.

Your data is stored in our database and is accessible only to your account. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes.

Uploaded images and audio are stored privately and are never published at public addresses.

The chatbot remembers long-term details only with your consent, and you can review, edit or delete that memory at any time.

You can download all of your data, or permanently delete your account and its data, from Account Settings.

We do not sell your personal information.
legal.termsBody:
By creating an account you agree to use HealthAssist AI for personal, lawful purposes.

The information provided is general in nature and is not medical advice. You are responsible for decisions about your health, and should consult a qualified professional.

Keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity on your account.

We may update these terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
legal.disclaimerBody:
HealthAssist AI is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Predictions are statistical estimates produced by machine-learning models trained on public datasets. They can be wrong and must not be used as the basis for medical decisions.

Chatbot answers are generated by AI and may contain errors. Do not delay seeking professional advice because of something you read here.

If you think you may have a medical emergency, call 112 or go to the nearest emergency department immediately.

help.title: Help and Support
help.intro: Answers to common questions about using HealthAssist AI.
help.emergencyBody: HealthAssist AI cannot help in an emergency. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
help.q1: How do I change my language?
help.a1: Use the language selector in the top bar, or open Language Preferences from the profile menu. Your choice is saved to your account.
help.q2: How do I reset my password?
help.a2: On the login page, choose "Forgot password?" and follow the link we email you. The link works once and expires after 30 minutes.
help.q3: How do I delete my data?
help.a3: Go to Account Settings. You can download your data, or delete your account and everything stored with it.
